latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Generator Free AI App skill.

- Generate ready-to-share 1080p videos from images or text prompts for free using cloud GPUs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB; other common formats also allowed.
- Automatic setup with anonymous-token or user token for session management (no installation needed).
- Handles file upload, video editing instructions, credits check, and project status via chat.
- Exports processed videos in about 1–2 minutes with downloadable MP4 links.
- Clear API error handling and user guidance for common issues (credits, file size, export limits).
